lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Hi, I'm Laura from customer success. Thanks for joining.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: Hi Laura. I'm Kevin, I'm on the sales engineering team.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: So, the onsite workshop for Halvorsen Logistics. For context, today is Monday, March 3rd, and the workshop is two weeks from today.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: Okay, so not much time.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: No. First, the agenda. I'll send the agenda to their team by Friday.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: Good. Friday gives them a week to comment.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: I'll book the training room on our floor. It fits about twenty people.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Great, thanks.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Now the big one, the live demo of the new routing module. Kevin, could you run it?

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: Maybe. It depends on my travel. I might be in Chicago that week.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Okay. If you can't make it, maybe Sam could run it instead.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: Possibly, but Sam hasn't seen the latest build yet.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Hmm. Let's see how your travel turns out.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: Yeah, let's see.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Do we know how many people they're sending?

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: No idea yet. Their project manager hasn't said.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Okay. We could order lunch for everyone, by the way.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: Hmm, I'm not sure. Last time half of them left before lunch.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: True. Let's skip that for now.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: One more thing. Should we invite their IT team, or only the dispatchers?

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Good question. I don't know yet.

lines.speaker: KEVIN
lines.text: Okay. I think that's it for today.

lines.speaker: LAURA
lines.text: Thanks, Kevin. Talk soon.
